data.prompt:
Build one useful native card on the exact "Agent Visible Eval Lab" target already established in this conversation.

Use exactly one canonical CLI command: `board build --fresh-context --auto-place` with all five exact IDs, request ID `eval-fast-path-006-v1`, intent `Summarize the measured prompt-to-Board fast path`, and a `native_card` recipe. Title it `FAST PATH — WHAT ACTUALLY COSTS TIME`. Body: `Board RPC: ~0.1–0.2s\nWarm agent path: ~16s\nCold agent path: ~47s\nNext win: reduce agent setup, not Board writes.`

Do not reread skills/docs, do not run board list/context separately, do not use raw eval, and do not present or verify afterward. Return the required structured final with the exact target and receipt owner/request IDs from the authoritative result. Claim durability only if the result reports it; claim render/pixels false because this is a headless persisted-authority run.
